title: A Singular Control Problem for Data Center Electricity Cost Minimization
summary: The goal of the paper is to provide a complete analysis of a stochastic control problem when the cost to minimize involves the running maximum of the underlying controlled state process. The model is motivated by the electricity cost minimization of a data center facing coincident peak charges and possibly benefiting from participation in a demand-response program. From a mathematical standpoint, the main challenge comes from the inclusion of the running maximum in the state of the system forcing the original problem into a singular stochastic control problem on a closed wedge in the plane…
